Name: Diamond Tools (replaces Iridium)
Author: RemyLoop
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Hand-made re-textures for all iridium tools with options to both rename them and/or swap diamonds and iridium with each other in other instances[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Extract into [i]steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/mods/[/i][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Edited items:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Diamond re-textures for the Iridium Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe, Watering Can, Fishing Rods, Pan, and Trash Can[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional re-naming of said tools to reflect the new material[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional swaps diamonds and iridium with each other[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Not included:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Iridium Band (re-texture felt out of place)[/*]
[*]Iridium Sprinkler (many other mods already replace it)[/*]
[/list][b]Available Languages:[/b]
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]German[/*]
[*]French[/*]
[*]Spanish[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (required)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (required)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25258]Colorful Fishing Rods[/url] (optional)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Big thanks to Konban for the French translation and to my other friend (you know who you are) for the Spanish translation![/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Absolutely NO AI was used in any step of the process of making this.[/b][/color]
